units.source_text: 且说夕雾左大臣把六条院内的东殿装饰得辉煌灿烂，一切布置设备尽善尽美，专等匂亲王来入赘。

en.t: Now Yugiri, the Left Minister, had decorated the eastern wing within Rokujo-in in dazzling splendor, arranging every furnishing and detail to perfection, and was waiting only for Prince Niou to come as the groom.

units.source_text: 十六夜的团明月渐渐上升，而匂亲王杳无消息。

en.t: The round, bright moon of the sixteenth night gradually rose, but there was still no word at all from Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 左大臣等得心焦了，想道：“匂亲王对此婚事本来不甚热心，难道不肯来么？”

en.t: The Left Minister grew anxious from waiting and thought, "Prince Niou was never very eager about this marriage. Could it be that he refuses to come?"

units.source_text: 心中忐忑不安，便派人去探听消息。

en.t: Unable to calm his uneasy heart, he sent someone to find out what had happened.

units.source_text: 使者回来报告：“亲王于今天傍晚从宫中退出，往二条院去了。”

en.t: The messenger returned and reported, "This evening the prince left the palace and went to Nijo-in."

units.source_text: 左大臣知道他在二条院有情人，心甚不快。

en.t: The Left Minister knew that he had a lover at Nijo-in, and he felt deeply displeased.

units.source_text: 设想今夜他如果不来，我将被世人耻笑了。

en.t: He imagined that if the prince did not come tonight, he himself would become the laughingstock of the world.

units.source_text: 便特派儿子头中将到二条院去迎接，赠诗一首：

en.t: So he specially sent his son, the Captain, to Nijo-in to bring him back, and sent along a poem:
